__.lastyy.__: Bastian "Bones" Lastyy arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Bastian "Bones" Lastyy stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Bastian "Bones" Lastyy tried to remember the price of a loaf in Varenne. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Bastian "Bones" Lastyy watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at Q-F20 and grazed Bastian "Bones" Lastyy's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Jakub Dersteven of the Hegemony (@dersteven_04).
The medic looked at Bastian "Bones" Lastyy's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to Q-F20. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Bastian "Bones" Lastyy carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
A flare caught Bastian "Bones" Lastyy halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
A round went through Bastian "Bones" Lastyy's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Arno Larpinhimer of the Hegemony (@larpinhimer1488).
_hunter_warren_: Wendel "Shadow" Warren came up with a draft of replacements on Day 6. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Wendel "Shadow" Warren wrote a letter for Karel Mccauley's mother, because Karel could not find the words. Karel signed it.
Wendel "Shadow" Warren pulled Matthias Fxx out of a flooded shell hole at Lantern Hill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

Wendel "Shadow" Warren found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. A letter from home found Wendel "Shadow" Warren before the night shift. Wendel "Shadow" Warren folded it small and kept it close.

A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Leopold "Brick" Moovin's name scratched on it. Wendel "Shadow" Warren kicked it back. It did not come again. A letter from home found Wendel "Shadow" Warren before the night shift. Wendel "Shadow" Warren folded it small and kept it close.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Wendel "Shadow" Warren could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home found Wendel "Shadow" Warren before the night shift. Wendel "Shadow" Warren folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel "Shadow" Warren cut Dietrich "Brick" Correaa's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. A letter from home found Wendel "Shadow" Warren before the night shift. Wendel "Shadow" Warren folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Wendel "Shadow" Warren is number 405 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Now serving as a stretcher bearer, Wendel "Shadow" Warren discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Wendel "Shadow" Warren shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Wendel "Shadow" Warren borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home found Wendel "Shadow" Warren before the night shift. Wendel "Shadow" Warren folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel "Shadow" Warren sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking. A letter from home found Wendel "Shadow" Warren before the night shift. Wendel "Shadow" Warren folded it small and kept it close.
Wendel "Shadow" Warren has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.

Wendel "Shadow" Warren borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. A letter from home found Wendel "Shadow" Warren before the night shift. Wendel "Shadow" Warren folded it small and kept it close.

The dugout has begun inventing endings to Wendel "Shadow" Warren's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing. Wendel "Shadow" Warren kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
benb0y: Viktor Benb reached N-F22 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
blaze_won_tv: Otto Won arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

A bullet hit the sandbag beside Otto Won. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In U-F21, Otto Won listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Otto Won tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Walter Byzantineemp and Otto Won tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Otto Won fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Yann "Ash" Duperow was grazed. Otto Won ate breakfast without a word.
On sentry duty Otto Won watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
A loose thread in Otto Won's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
caden.w26: Quentin Caden came up the line in the rain with a rosary of rough beads and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Quentin Caden during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Quentin Caden made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Rumour reached S-F6 that the war would be over by spring. Quentin Caden has heard it before. So has everyone.

Quentin Caden got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Quentin Caden watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A man asked Quentin Caden to describe Coldwater without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Quentin Caden wrote back to Clara and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
Quentin Caden of the Concord and Edmund Ringwraith of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Calvary Farm now wait for it before they sleep.
No post for Quentin Caden this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-F6, Quentin Caden listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A parcel from Clara: socks, a cake gone hard as a brick, and a pressed flower. Quentin Caden ate the cake and kept the flower in a rosary of rough beads's place. The clerk counted the names twice. Quentin Caden is number 169 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Quentin Caden stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Quentin Caden felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Silas "Bones" Hunterplum of the Hegemony (@hunterplum).
Quentin Caden rejoined the squad at S-F6. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
The colonel asked who held the line at Grey Mill last night. Every finger pointed at Quentin Caden. Lance Corporal.

Quentin Caden was carrying water up to S-F6 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Quentin Caden did not. Shot by Cyril Bmx of the Hegemony (@ian_bmx_51). Quentin Caden stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F6. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Cyril Bmx of the Hegemony (@ian_bmx_51).
The House of Caden sent another. Rafael Caden, father of Quentin Caden, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Rafael Caden (Concord) watched Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Grey Mill, and held fire until both were gone.
des_9419: Day 10: Bram Des reached P-F7 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Bram Des and Otto Benryderfitz spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Bram Des wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Bram Des spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.

Bram Des was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at P-F7. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon of the Hegemony (@ashtheslowone).
The medics cleaned Bram Des's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at P-F7.
Across from P-F7, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Bram Des saw it. Viktor "Bones" Jcortes was grazed.
Bram Des brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from the Drowned Farm in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now.
hogggogins: Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins came up the line with a bullet that missed him and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home. Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Otto Sebastian was grazed.
A clear shot from T-F7. Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins grazed Wendel Scottkurom and slid back down below the parapet.
Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Konrad Preston was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins and Gideon "Parson" Gibbons compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
indinsea01z: Silas Indinsea came up the line with a bullet that missed him and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

The cook borrowed Silas Indinsea's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Silas Indinsea watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Silas Indinsea. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.

A bullet went into Silas Indinsea's chest just under the heart at U-F17. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Nils "Brick" Antonio of the Hegemony (@antonio.u07). Silas Indinsea was killed on watch at U-F17. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Nils "Brick" Antonio of the Hegemony (@antonio.u07).
A letter came with Cyril Indinsea: "I am Silas Indinsea's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Cyril Indinsea fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F17. Severin Vonmaverick was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Cyril Indinsea found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.
Pavel "Spark" Tmpar fixed the strap on Cyril Indinsea's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
jak_11.7: In Belmonte, Hugo Jak was a schoolteacher. In P-F10, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a schoolteacher again.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Hugo Jak added a leak above the man's head in pencil. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Hugo Jak stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The sergeant at P-F10 called out a range and a spot. Hugo Jak was the only one who hit it. Silas Robertdpayne was grazed.
At Calvary Farm, Viktor Pauar and Hugo Jak exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Hugo Jak across the shin at P-F10. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Gustav Bobopomaranc of the Hegemony (@bobopomarancza).
Hugo Jak came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
At P-F10 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Hugo Jak won the bet. Severin "Doc" Soukup was grazed.
jb_bourque: At the depot, Jonas Bourque had practised answering to his name. At V-F15, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
A parcel came for Jonas Bourque that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: three pairs of woollen mittens. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
The parcel's address was smudged. Jonas Bourque took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry.

At V-F15 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Jonas Bourque turned around and took a shovel blow. Karel "Mud" Ajango of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Karel "Mud" Ajango of the Concord (@ajango117).
jules95s: Day 9. The corporal put Quentin "Brick" Jules beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Quentin "Brick" Jules stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Quentin "Brick" Jules found a chair in the barn and sat down carefully, as if it might be reserved for someone of higher rank. The clerk counted the names twice. Quentin "Brick" Jules is number 997 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-R2 with the rations. Quentin "Brick" Jules ate while listening to the revised orders.
Viktor Imposterdonu kept watch so that Quentin "Brick" Jules could sleep. Then Brick kept watch so that Viktor could. Neither slept.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of R-R2. When Quentin "Brick" Jules challenged it, there was nobody there.
Quentin "Brick" Jules found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Quentin "Brick" Jules hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Quentin "Brick" Jules sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
louieeeisokaywiththis: The old hands of V-F6 have been here since Day 1. Severin "Spark" Louieeeisoka has been here since Day 14. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Severin "Spark" Louieeeisoka laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.

In the dark of the Concord trench Severin "Spark" Louieeeisoka hit Valentin Nothing with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@nothing_va1) Severin "Spark" Louieeeisoka crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Marek Enjoyer reached for a rifle. Severin "Spark" Louieeeisoka was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@red3.enjoyer) Severin "Spark" Louieeeisoka got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.
max_chenier_: Ivo "Shadow" Chenier arrived at T-F2 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Ivo "Shadow" Chenier offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at T-F2 changed before the cheering ended. Ivo "Shadow" Chenier shouldered another load.
Ivo "Shadow" Chenier and Wendel "Mud" Zno both swear they saw a ghost at the Brickworks. Each says the other screamed first.
Ivo "Shadow" Chenier and Jakub Damocles cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Ivo "Shadow" Chenier kept Wendel "Mud" Zno awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Shadow could have walked there blind.
The trench wall shook against Ivo "Shadow" Chenier's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
On sentry duty Ivo "Shadow" Chenier watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
moonroleen: By the time Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen reached N-F18, the war was 11 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork.
Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at the Hanging Bridge. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Wendel Rebootreboot: 'Fair trade.'
Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely and Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.

Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen fired at a movement across the wire at N-F18. The man went down: Severin Senicfilms, badly wounded. A clear shot from N-F18. Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen badly wounded Roland Rambo and slid back down below the parapet.
Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Felix Nestorickdav was gravely wounded.
mrbojo1992: Bastian Mrbojo arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

The gun at R-C2 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Konrad Embersky, badly wounded. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-C2, Bastian Mrbojo listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Bastian Mrbojo cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry. Bastian Mrbojo got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 775. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-C2. Bastian Mrbojo has learned to walk bent double.

Bastian Mrbojo had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Jakub "Whistle" Floooring was badly wounded. A bullet hit Bastian Mrbojo's belt buckle at R-C2 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Marek Seths of the Hegemony (@seths110).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Bastian Mrbojo is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Bastian Mrbojo saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-C2 and fired once. Severin Latsch was grazed.
A shell splinter cut through Bastian Mrbojo's sleeve at R-C2 and left a red line across his arm. He tied a rag around it and kept watch.
The wound on Bastian Mrbojo's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
paraop96: Rafael Paraop introduced himself as a brewer from Ashford Vale. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Rafael Paraop read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Rafael Paraop obtained a recipe for a steamed suet pudding. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Rafael Paraop watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Rafael Paraop found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Rafael Paraop accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout.

Rafael Paraop was hit twice at T-F21, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Albin Welcometomem of the Hegemony (@welcometomemetown2.0). Rafael Paraop looked over the parapet at T-F21 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Albin Welcometomem of the Hegemony (@welcometomemetown2.0).
The papers say Ivo Paraop. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Rafael Paraop's eyes. Nobody in T-F21 argues.
Ivo Paraop made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking.
Rain washed the chalk names from the trench signs. Ivo Paraop spent the evening directing strangers past the same junction.
rossfm82: On the way to S-S6, Leopold Rossfm tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way. After what happened at Sorrow Copse, Leopold Rossfm asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.

Leopold Rossfm lay in the ruins of Lantern Hill from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory. A letter from home found Leopold Rossfm before the night shift. Leopold Rossfm folded it small and kept it close.
Leopold Rossfm noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Leopold Rossfm said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.

A bullet went through Leopold Rossfm's upper arm at S-S6 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Otto "Parson" Vicious of the Hegemony (@darth._.vicious). Leopold Rossfm was killed outright at S-S6, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Otto "Parson" Vicious of the Hegemony (@darth._.vicious).
Henrik Rossfm had heard about Leopold Rossfm's courage. At S-S6, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

The relief column arrived early. Henrik Rossfm made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep. Henrik Rossfm got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 455. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-S6, Henrik Rossfm listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Henrik Rossfm saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
Henrik Rossfm started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
Henrik Rossfm fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Dorian "Saint" Dallas was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.

Henrik Rossfm fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Gideon Oliverjarret, now badly wounded. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Henrik Rossfm aimed a step ahead and fired: Arno Passenger, grazed.
Henrik Rossfm had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Jonas Gaita, grazed.
sedlomancz: Henrik Sedlomancz reported to R-F14 with a pocket Bible with a hole in it sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Henrik Sedlomancz's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.
Henrik Sedlomancz left the work of a rifleman to become a runner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

The company barber offered a choice of styles. Henrik Sedlomancz asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into R-F14. Henrik Sedlomancz has learned to walk bent double.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Henrik Sedlomancz worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at Lantern Hill. Henrik Sedlomancz fired. Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.' A letter from home found Henrik Sedlomancz before the night shift. Henrik Sedlomancz folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel "Mole" Freddie lent Henrik Sedlomancz a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Henrik Sedlomancz wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Henrik Sedlomancz dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. A letter from home found Henrik Sedlomancz before the night shift. Henrik Sedlomancz folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik Sedlomancz measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together. A letter from home found Henrik Sedlomancz before the night shift. Henrik Sedlomancz folded it small and kept it close.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Henrik Sedlomancz across the shin at R-F14. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Gideon Actioncam of the Concord (@actioncam3000).

A bullet struck Henrik Sedlomancz below the ribs at R-F14. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Florian "Doc" Guyy of the Concord (@proto_guyy). A letter from home found Henrik Sedlomancz before the night shift. Henrik Sedlomancz folded it small and kept it close.
There was no room for Henrik Sedlomancz. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.

Another member of the House of Sedlomancz reached the line: Ivo Sedlomancz. He asked where Henrik Sedlomancz had slept, then chose a different corner. Number 57 on the early rolls: Ivo Sedlomancz. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.

Ivo Sedlomancz bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. Victory at Grey Mill. Ivo Sedlomancz let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Ivo Sedlomancz practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
Ivo Sedlomancz owes Isidor Serrano so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
A local carter understood Ivo Sedlomancz's request for bread, then explained that the same sentence sounded very much like a request for a beard.
Ivo Sedlomancz corrected the phrasebook in pencil. The carter added three useful expressions and refused to translate a fourth suggested by the corporal.

Ivo Sedlomancz was on the dawn watch at R-F14 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Ivo Sedlomancz was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Bastian Wizzerd of the Concord (@flying_wizzerd).
shokun8383: Day 13. The corporal put Henrik Shokun beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Henrik Shokun (Hegemony) and Leopold Evans (Concord) came to the same broken well at the Chalk Pits at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away. A letter from home found Henrik Shokun before the night shift. Henrik Shokun folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik Shokun was found at the bottom of the trench at N-F15, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Wendel "Spark" Itfc of the Concord (@stanleyl_itfc). The bearers reached Henrik Shokun at N-F15 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Wendel "Spark" Itfc of the Concord (@stanleyl_itfc).
Clement "Doc" Shokun asked about Henrik Shokun on arriving at N-F15. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Clement "Doc" Shokun only heard boots on the duckboards at N-F15, then nothing but pain. Raider: Bastian "Mud" Bnfts of the Concord (@b3n3f1ts). Clement "Doc" Shokun was carried to the aid post and straight back out. Full. He waits on a stretcher by the door, holding a rosary of rough beads.
simonb112727: Gustav Simonb, a postman from Coldwater, was sent forward on Day 14 to fill a gap in V-F19. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Gustav Simonb heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at V-F19. Gustav Simonb was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Dietrich Infante of the Concord (@cris_infante6).
Valentin "Saint" Simonb joined V-F19 under the shadow of Gustav Simonb's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
the_mechanical_hardware: Jakub "Doc" Hardware found a place in N-F4 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

Jakub "Doc" Hardware was on the dawn watch at N-F4 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Jakub "Doc" Hardware was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Karel "Owl" Paul of the Concord (@spooky_month_paul).
tripletonyt: Day 10: Konrad Tripletonyt reached U-F21 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Konrad Tripletonyt read a theatre review while peeling supper. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Konrad Tripletonyt wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Konrad Tripletonyt held the mirror while Otto Won shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. A letter from home found Konrad Tripletonyt before the night shift. Konrad Tripletonyt folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Tripletonyt caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. A letter from home found Konrad Tripletonyt before the night shift. Konrad Tripletonyt folded it small and kept it close.

winters_ist_hier: Karel Hier, a shepherd from Port Abel, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in V-F11. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Karel Hier gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Karel Hier kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Karel Hier and Benedikt Lorenz compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.

Karel Hier went down at Sorrow Copse and did not get up. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Karel Hier finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
The bleeding has stopped. Karel Hier asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen.

The stretcher Karel Hier lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Karel Hier is back at V-F11, and someone else is lying in that dent now. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Hier. Karel Hier read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Karel Hier became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

At V-F11 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Karel Hier turned around and took a shovel blow. Konrad Alexandernym of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Konrad Alexandernym of the Hegemony (@alexandernymannn). Karel Hier came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. The mail bag came up with the soup.
